items.distractor_fact: سجّلت محطة الرصد في مدينة مجاورة درجة حرارة بلغت {D}°م في نفس الصباح.
items.gloss_en: The observation station in a neighboring city recorded a temperature of {D}°C that same morning.
items.entity_note: A different weather station, in a neighboring city, from the one whose morning/evening readings the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: أغلق سهم شركة أخرى في نفس اليوم عند {D}$.
items.gloss_en: Another company's stock closed that same day at {D}$.
items.entity_note: A different company's stock, not the one whose opening/closing price the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: حافظت طائرة أخرى على ارتفاع بلغ {D} م خلال نفس الفترة.
items.gloss_en: Another plane maintained an altitude of {D} m during the same period.
items.entity_note: A different aircraft than the one whose climb altitude the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: بلغ رصيد حساب زبون آخر في ذلك الوقت {D}$.
items.gloss_en: Another customer's account balance at that time was {D}$.
items.entity_note: A different customer's bank account, not the one in the story.

items.distractor_fact: أودع مدّخر آخر في حسابه خلال الشهر نفسه مبلغ {D}$.
items.gloss_en: Another saver deposited {D}$ into their account during that same month.
items.entity_note: A different saver's account; only their deposit is stated, with no matching withdrawal, so no second subtraction can be formed.

items.distractor_fact: بلغ دخل أسرة أخرى خلال الشهر نفسه {D}$.
items.gloss_en: Another family's income during that same month was {D}$.
items.entity_note: A different family; only their income is stated, with no matching expenses given.

items.distractor_fact: سجّل فريق آخر في الدوري نفسه خلال الموسم عددًا من الأهداف بلغ {D}.
items.gloss_en: Another team in the same league scored {D} goals during the season.
items.entity_note: A different team; only goals scored is stated, with no conceded count given, so no second subtraction can be formed.

items.distractor_fact: حقق مستثمر آخر من صفقاته الرابحة خلال العام نفسه مبلغ {D}$.
items.gloss_en: Another investor made {D}$ from their winning trades during that same year.
items.entity_note: A different investor; only their gains are stated, with no matching losses given.

items.distractor_fact: أنتج مصنع آخر خلال الشهر نفسه عددًا من الوحدات بلغ {D}، وله هدف إنتاج خاص به لم يُذكر.
items.gloss_en: Another factory produced {D} units during that same month, and has its own production target, which was not stated.
items.entity_note: A different factory with its own, unstated target, so its output cannot be paired against the story's target.

items.distractor_fact: بلغت كمية الأمطار الفعلية التي هطلت في منطقة أخرى خلال الشهر نفسه {D} ملم، بحسب نشرة جوية مختلفة.
items.gloss_en: The actual rainfall that fell in another region during that same month was {D} mm, according to a different weather bulletin.
items.entity_note: A different region with its own separate forecast bulletin, whose forecast value is not stated.

items.distractor_fact: أنهى لاعب آخر الجولة على ملعب مختلف بعدد ضربات بلغ {D}.
items.gloss_en: A different player finished the round on a different course with {D} strokes.
items.entity_note: A different player on a different course whose par is not stated.

items.distractor_fact: أنهت لاعبة أخرى الجولة على ملعب مختلف تمامًا بعدد ضربات بلغ {D}.
items.gloss_en: A different player finished the round on an entirely different course with {D} strokes.
items.entity_note: A different player on an entirely different course whose par is not stated.

items.distractor_fact: وصل قطار آخر يسير على خط مختلف تمامًا فعليًا عند الدقيقة {D} محسوبة من منتصف الليل.
items.gloss_en: Another train, running on an entirely different line, actually arrived at minute-mark {D} counted from midnight.
items.entity_note: A different train on a different line; its scheduled time is not stated.

items.distractor_fact: توقف مصعد آخر في مبنى مختلف عند الطابق الذي يحمل الرقم {D}.
items.gloss_en: Another elevator, in a different building, stopped at the floor numbered {D}.
items.entity_note: A different elevator in a different building, whose reference floor is not stated.

items.distractor_fact: سجّل أحد الفرق في مباراة أخرى عددًا من الأهداف بلغ {D}.
items.gloss_en: A team in a different match scored {D} goals.
items.entity_note: A different match; only one team's score is stated, with no opposing score given.
